objects.description: [GoldenSpy](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0493) constantly attempts to download and execute files from the remote C2, including [GoldenSpy](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0493) itself if not found on the system.(Citation: Trustwave GoldenSpy June 2020)
objects.description_fa: [GoldenSpy](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0493) دائماً تلاش می‌کند تا فایل‌ها را از راه دور C2 دانلود و اجرا کند، از جمله خود [GoldenSpy](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0493) اگر در سیستم یافت نشد.(Citation: Trustwave GoldenSpy June 2020)
